title: Everything you need for PDFs
subtitle: Five specialized tools. Pick one, drop your file, done.

merge.title: Merge PDF
merge.desc: Combine multiple PDFs into a single document. Drag to reorder pages.

split.title: Split PDF
split.desc: Extract specific pages or split a PDF into individual page files.

ocr.title: OCR PDF
ocr.desc: Make scanned documents searchable with optical character recognition.

pdfToWord.title: PDF to Word
pdfToWord.desc: Convert PDF documents to editable .docx files with formatting preserved.

imageToPdf.title: Image to PDF
imageToPdf.desc: Convert JPG, PNG, or WebP images into a single PDF document.

comingSoon.title: More coming soon
comingSoon.desc: Edit, annotate, compress, watermark — building more every week.
